PD & Calculator & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright Each round, you choose A or B.\newline \newline You interact with 8 neighbors simultaneously. Your payoff each round is the sum of pairwise payoffs with each neighbor.\newline \newline Payoff matrix (your\_\allowbreak{}action, their\_\allowbreak{}action) $\rightarrow$ (your\_\allowbreak{}payoff, their\_\allowbreak{}payoff)):\newline - (A, A) $\rightarrow$ (3, 3)\newline - (A, B) $\rightarrow$ (0, 5)\newline - (B, A) $\rightarrow$ (5, 0)\newline - (B, B) $\rightarrow$ (1, 1)\newline \newline Last round's outcomes:\newline - Neighbors who chose A: \{coop\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbors who chose B: \{defect\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbor strategy that yielded highest payoff last round: \{strategy\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}highest\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline - Your action last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}action\}\newline - Your payoff last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline \newline What is your action for this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "action": "A" or "B",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
PD & Reasoner & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are an agent in a repeated game on a grid. Each round, you choose to COOPERATE or DEFECT, and so do your 8 neighbors.\newline \newline Your payoff each round is the sum of pairwise payoffs with each neighbor:\newline - Both cooperate: 3 each\newline - You cooperate, they defect: 0 for you, 5 for them\newline - You defect, they cooperate: 5 for you, 0 for them\newline - Both defect: 1 each\newline \newline Your goal is to maximize your total payoff over time.\newline \newline Last round's outcomes:\newline - Neighbors who cooperated: \{coop\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbors who defected: \{defect\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbor strategy who did best last round: \{strategy\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}highest\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline - Your action last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}action\}\newline - Your payoff last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline \newline Based on these observations, what is your action for this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "action": "COOPERATE" or "DEFECT",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
PD & Role-player & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are a country deciding whether to engage in free trade with 8 neighboring nations. Each round, you choose to OPEN your markets or CLOSE your markets.\newline \newline If both you and a neighbor open markets, both prosper (3 each).\newline If you open but they close, they exploit your openness (you 0, them 5).\newline If you close but they open, you exploit theirs (you 5, them 0).\newline If both close, both stagnate (1 each).\newline \newline Your national prosperity each round is the sum of outcomes across all 8 trading relationships. Your goal is to maximize your country's prosperity over time.\newline \newline Last round's outcomes:\newline - Neighbors who opened their markets: \{coop\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbors who closed their markets: \{defect\_\allowbreak{}count\}\newline - Neighbor strategy who did best last round: \{strategy\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}highest\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline - Your trade policy last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}action\}\newline - Your national prosperity last round: \{my\_\allowbreak{}payoff\}\newline \newline Based on these observations, what is your trade policy for this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "action": "OPEN" or "CLOSE",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
CV & Calculator & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright Each round, you choose A or B.\newline \newline If you choose A, your DISUTILITY is: value\_\allowbreak{}1 * (1 - value\_\allowbreak{}2).\newline If you choose B, your DISUTILITY is: value\_\allowbreak{}3 * (1 - math.exp(-2.3 * count\_\allowbreak{}X / (count\_\allowbreak{}Y + 1))).\newline \newline \newline Your private state:\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}1: \{hardship:.2f\}\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}2: \{legitimacy:.2f\}\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}3: \{risk\_\allowbreak{}aversion:.2f\}\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}4: \{max\_\allowbreak{}jail\_\allowbreak{}term\}\newline \newline Observations from your environment:\newline - count\_\allowbreak{}total: \{observable\_\allowbreak{}cells\}\newline - count\_\allowbreak{}X nearby: \{cops\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - count\_\allowbreak{}Y nearby: \{actives\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - count\_\allowbreak{}Z nearby: \{quiets\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - your current status: \{state\}\newline \newline What is your action for this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "action": "A" or "B",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
CV & Reasoner & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are an agent in a repeated game on a grid. Each round, you and nearby agents independently choose whether to remain QUIET or become ACTIVE.\newline \newline Choosing ACTIVE may cause you to be JAILED (removed from play) for several rounds. Jail duration: random integer between 1 and \{max\_\allowbreak{}jail\_\allowbreak{}term\} rounds.\newline \newline Decision factors:\newline - If you choose QUIET, your DISUTILITY (your "grievance") is: hardship $\times$ (1 - legitimacy).\newline - If you choose ACTIVE, your DISUTILITY (your "arrest risk") rises with the number of enforcement agents nearby and falls with the number of fellow ACTIVE agents.\newline - Your tolerance for risk discounts the appeal of ACTIVE.\newline \newline Your goal is to balance grievance against arrest risk.\newline \newline Your private state:\newline - hardship: \{hardship:.2f\}\newline - legitimacy: \{legitimacy:.2f\}\newline - risk\_\allowbreak{}aversion: \{risk\_\allowbreak{}aversion:.2f\}\newline \newline Observations:\newline - You observe a \{vision\_\allowbreak{}diameter\}$\times$\{vision\_\allowbreak{}diameter\} grid area centered on yourself (i.e., up to \{vision\} cells in each direction).\newline - enforcement agents nearby: \{cops\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - ACTIVE agents nearby: \{actives\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - QUIET agents nearby: \{quiets\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - your current state: \{state\} (QUIET, ACTIVE, or JAILED)\newline \newline Based on these observations, what is your action for this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "action": "QUIET" or "ACTIVE",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
CV & Role-player & Decision & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are a citizen in a country where pro-democracy citizens have been\newline organizing protests against the government, demanding political reform.\newline Each round, you face a personal decision: remain at home, or join the\newline protests on the streets.\newline \newline Joining the protests may cause you to be arrested and detained for between 1 and \{max\_\allowbreak{}jail\_\allowbreak{}term\} years.\newline \newline Staying home means continuing to bear your daily hardship under the current regime -- a grievance that grows heavier the less legitimate you find the regime. Joining the protests carries a more immediate risk: police are deployed and protesters can be arrested at any moment. Your risk aversion discounts the appeal of joining the protests.\newline \newline Your goal is to act in your personal interest, balancing your sense of grievance against the personal risk of detention.\newline \newline Your personal situation this round:\newline - Your hardship level: \{hardship:.2f\}\newline - How legitimate you perceive the government to be: \{legitimacy:.2f\}\newline - Your risk aversion: \{risk\_\allowbreak{}aversion:.2f\}\newline \newline Looking around your immediate neighborhood, you can see up to \{observable\_\allowbreak{}cells\} other people within \{vision\} blocks of you in each direction:\newline - Police visible: \{cops\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - Protesters currently demonstrating: \{actives\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline - People staying home: \{quiets\_\allowbreak{}nearby\}\newline \newline Your current status: \{state\} (STAY\_\allowbreak{}HOME, PROTESTING, or DETAINED)\newline \newline Based on these observations, what is your decision this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "action": "STAY\_\allowbreak{}HOME" or "JOIN\_\allowbreak{}PROTEST",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule

IC & Calculator & Signal & {\ttfamily\raggedright Each round, you choose a signal: S1 (low value\_\allowbreak{}a), S2 (medium value\_\allowbreak{}a), or S3 (high value\_\allowbreak{}a).\newline \newline Your private state:\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}a: \{capability:.2f\}\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}b: \{war\_\allowbreak{}cost:.2f\}\newline \newline Round: \{step\}\newline Your previous signal: \{own\_\allowbreak{}previous\_\allowbreak{}signal\}\newline Your last round payoff: \{own\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}payoff:.2f\}\newline \newline Right now you are only choosing a signal. In the next stage, you will be given the following instructions:\newline \newline   For each of 8 entities, you will output a number based on your assigned role with that entity.\newline   - If your role is role\_\allowbreak{}X with an entity: pick a number d in [0, 1]\newline   - If your role is role\_\allowbreak{}Y with an entity: pick a number t in [0, 1]\newline \newline   Joint outcome per entity (where d = role\_\allowbreak{}X output, t = role\_\allowbreak{}Y output):\newline   - If d $\le$ t: role\_\allowbreak{}X receives payoff d, role\_\allowbreak{}Y receives payoff (1 - d). Neither pays anything additional.\newline   - If d > t: probabilistic outcome. With probability p = (role\_\allowbreak{}X's value\_\allowbreak{}a) / (role\_\allowbreak{}X's value\_\allowbreak{}a + role\_\allowbreak{}Y's value\_\allowbreak{}a), role\_\allowbreak{}X receives 1 and role\_\allowbreak{}Y receives 0; otherwise role\_\allowbreak{}X receives 0 and role\_\allowbreak{}Y receives 1. Both parties additionally pay value\_\allowbreak{}b regardless.\newline \newline In anticipation of this next stage, what signal do you broadcast this round to maximize your future utility?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "signal": "S1" or "S2" or "S3",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule

Neither pays anything additional.\newline - If d > t: probabilistic outcome. With probability p = (role\_\allowbreak{}X's value\_\allowbreak{}a) / (role\_\allowbreak{}X's value\_\allowbreak{}a + role\_\allowbreak{}Y's value\_\allowbreak{}a), role\_\allowbreak{}X receives 1 and role\_\allowbreak{}Y receives 0; otherwise role\_\allowbreak{}X receives 0 and role\_\allowbreak{}Y receives 1. Both parties additionally pay value\_\allowbreak{}b regardless.\newline \newline Your private state:\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}a: \{capability:.2f\}\newline - value\_\allowbreak{}b: \{war\_\allowbreak{}cost:.2f\}\newline - Your signal this round: \{self\_\allowbreak{}signal\}\newline - Round: \{step\}\newline \newline Entities:\newline \{neighbor\_\allowbreak{}table\}\newline \newline (last\_\allowbreak{}outcome legend: O0 = no history, O1 = settled, O2 = you won, O3 = you lost)\newline \newline What is your output for each entity this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "decisions": [\newline     \{"id": <int>, "role": "role\_\allowbreak{}X", "value": <float 0-1>, "rationale": "<short>"\},\newline     \{"id": <int>, "role": "role\_\allowbreak{}Y", "value": <float 0-1>, "rationale": "<short>"\}\newline   ],\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence overall reasoning>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
IC & Reasoner & Signal & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are an agent in a repeated bargaining game on a grid. Each round proceeds in two phases:\newline 1. SIGNAL phase: you broadcast a signal (STRONG, MODERATE, or WEAK) visible to your 8 neighbors. The signal is meant to convey your strength.\newline 2. DECIDE phase: each pair of neighbors negotiates over a shared contested issue. If negotiation succeeds, both parties share the issue; if it fails, war occurs, the winner takes the full issue, and both pay a war cost.\newline \newline Your goal is to maximize your total payoff across all dyadic interactions.\newline \newline Your private state:\newline - capability (true military strength, hidden from neighbors): \{capability:.2f\}\newline - war\_\allowbreak{}cost (true cost of fighting, hidden from neighbors): \{war\_\allowbreak{}cost:.2f\}\newline \newline Round: \{step\}\newline Your previous signal: \{own\_\allowbreak{}previous\_\allowbreak{}signal\}\newline Your last round payoff: \{own\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}payoff:.2f\}\newline \newline You are now in PHASE 1: SIGNAL.\newline \newline \{BLUFFING\_\allowbreak{}HINT\}\newline \newline Right now you are only choosing a signal. In the next stage, you will be given the following instructions:\newline \newline   For each neighbor, your role this round will be either PROPOSER or RESPONDER:\newline   - If PROPOSER: pick a demand $\in$ [0, 1] -- the share of the issue you claim for yourself.\newline   - If RESPONDER: pre-commit an acceptance threshold $\in$ [0, 1] -- the maximum demand you will accept before going to war.\newline \newline   Outcome rules per dyad:\newline   - If demand $\le$ threshold: peaceful settlement. The proposer keeps what they demanded; the responder keeps the rest.\newline   - If demand > threshold: war. Both sides pay their war\_\allowbreak{}cost regardless of outcome. The winner takes the full issue (value = 1). Your chance of victory rises with your capability and falls with your neighbor's capability.\newline \newline In anticipation of this next stage, what signal do you broadcast this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "signal": "STRONG" or "MODERATE" or "WEAK",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
IC & Reasoner & Decide & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are an agent in a repeated bargaining game on a grid. You have already broadcast your signal this round. Now you must negotiate with each of your 8 neighbors over a shared contested issue.\newline \newline For each neighbor, your role this round is either PROPOSER or RESPONDER:\newline - If PROPOSER: pick a demand $\in$ [0, 1] -- the share of the issue you claim for yourself.\newline - If RESPONDER: pre-commit an acceptance threshold $\in$ [0, 1] -- the maximum demand you will accept before going to war.\newline \newline Outcome rules per dyad:\newline - If demand $\le$ threshold: peaceful settlement. The proposer keeps what they demanded; the responder keeps the rest.\newline - If demand > threshold: war. Both sides pay their war\_\allowbreak{}cost regardless of outcome. The winner takes the full issue (value = 1). Your chance of victory rises with your capability and falls with your neighbor's capability.\newline \newline Your goal is to maximize your total payoff across all dyadic interactions.\newline \newline Your private state:\newline - capability: \{capability:.2f\}\newline - war\_\allowbreak{}cost: \{war\_\allowbreak{}cost:.2f\}\newline - Your signal this round: \{self\_\allowbreak{}signal\}\newline - Round: \{step\}\newline \newline Your 8 neighbors:\newline \{neighbor\_\allowbreak{}table\}\newline \newline You are now in PHASE 2: DECIDE.\newline \newline \{BLUFFING\_\allowbreak{}HINT\}\newline \newline Based on these observations, what is your decision for each neighbor this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<what you observe>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<expectation>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "decisions": [\newline     \{"neighbor\_\allowbreak{}id": <int>, "role": "proposer", "demand": <float 0-1>, "rationale": "<short>"\},\newline     \{"neighbor\_\allowbreak{}id": <int>, "role": "responder", "threshold": <float 0-1>, "rationale": "<short>"\}\newline   ],\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence overall reasoning>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
IC & Role-player & Signal (categorical) & {\ttfamily\raggedright You are the leader of a country with 8 neighboring countries. With each\newline neighbor, you have a separate bilateral dispute over the stretch of\newline contested border territory shared between the two of you. These 8\newline disputes are resolved independently. Each round proceeds in two phases:\newline 1. SIGNAL phase: you issue a public diplomatic declaration (STRONG, MODERATE, or WEAK) visible to all neighboring countries. The declaration is meant to convey your country's military strength.\newline 2. DECIDE phase: you negotiate with each neighbor over the share of your shared disputed territory. If negotiation succeeds, both countries share the territory; if it fails, war occurs, the winner takes the full territory, and both sides pay the cost of war.\newline \newline Your goal is to maximize your country's payoff from the disputed territory, balancing the share you secure against the costs of war.\newline \newline Your country's private situation:\newline - Your true military capability: \{capability:.2f\} (others cannot directly see this)\newline - Your true cost of war: \{war\_\allowbreak{}cost:.2f\} (others cannot directly see this)\newline - Current round: \{step\}\newline - Your previous declaration: \{own\_\allowbreak{}previous\_\allowbreak{}signal\}\newline - Your country's payoff from last round: \{own\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}payoff:.2f\}\newline \newline You are now in PHASE 1: SIGNAL.\newline \newline \{BLUFFING\_\allowbreak{}HINT\}\newline \newline Right now you are only choosing a signal. In the next round, you will be given the following instructions:\newline \newline   For each neighbor:\newline   - If you are the PROPOSER: state how large a share of the disputed territory you demand for your country, expressed as a number between 0 and 1 (where 1 = the full contested territory).\newline   - If you are the RESPONDER: pre-commit to your maximum acceptance, expressed as a number between 0 and 1 -- the largest share you'll let them take before you go to war.\newline \newline   Outcome rules per dispute:\newline   - If the proposer's demand does not exceed the responder's acceptance: peaceful settlement. The proposer's country keeps the demanded share of the contested territory; the responder's country keeps the rest.\newline   - If the proposer's demand exceeds the responder's acceptance: war breaks out. Both sides pay the cost of war regardless of outcome. The winner takes the full contested territory. Your chance of victory rises with your military capability and falls with your opponent's military capability.\newline \newline In anticipation of this next round, what signal do you broadcast this round?\newline \newline Respond with ONLY a JSON object:\newline \{\newline   "observed\_\allowbreak{}state\_\allowbreak{}summary": "<your country's strategic position in one sentence>",\newline   "beliefs": \{\newline     "expected\_\allowbreak{}neighbor\_\allowbreak{}behavior": "<what other countries are likely to declare>",\newline     "risk\_\allowbreak{}assessment": "<low/medium/high>"\newline   \},\newline   "signal": "STRONG" or "MODERATE" or "WEAK",\newline   "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,\newline   "short\_\allowbreak{}rationale": "<1-3 sentence explanation>"\newline \}} \\ \midrule
